Chooses whether a fast body is stopped by thin things instead of passing through them. Continuous detection costs more for that body.
@param entity The body.
@param mode 0 as `PhysicsContinuousDefault` says (default), 1 continuous, 2 never.
@gap The original has no such command. This is an extension; programs that use it do not compile with the original Blitz3D.
